description: Source code for cgroup validation in Linux environments within Kubernetes, including functions to detect cgroup mount points, validate cgroup subsystems, and handle cgroup v1/v2 differences.

classes.name: CgroupsValidator
classes.description: Validator for cgroup configuration in Linux, supporting both v1 and v2, with methods to validate subsystems and detect mount points.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the validator, 'cgroups'.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the cgroup configuration based on the system spec, checking for required and optional subsystems.

methods.name: getCgroupV1Subsystems
methods.description: Reads /proc/cgroups to list available cgroup v1 subsystems.

methods.name: getCgroupV2Subsystems
methods.description: Reads cgroup controllers from the v2 filesystem and checks for freezer controller support.

methods.name: isCgroupsV1DisabledInKubelet
methods.description: Determines if cgroups v1 support is disabled based on the Kubelet version.
